爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 AHR037 浅羽夏子Asawa Natsuko-最乖的女仆
主人坐在沙发上，乖巧的女仆窝在脚边，轻轻脱下他的皮鞋。
指尖无意间擦过脚踝，她抬起头，红着脸轻声问：“主人，还需要我……再靠近一点吗？”
声音软得像棉花糖，眼睛却亮晶晶地盯着他。
“最乖的女仆，永远只听主人的话。”
她把脸贴在他膝上，呼吸温热，带着一丝小心翼翼的依赖与期待。
身型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink AHR037 Asawa Natsuko-The Most Obedient Maid
The master sat on the sofa, the obedient maid nestled at his feet, gently removing his shoes.
Her fingertips accidentally brushed against his ankle. She looked up, her face flushed, and whispered, "Master, would you like me... a little closer?"
Her voice was as soft as cotton candy, but her eyes sparkled as she gazed at him.
"The most obedient maid always listens only to her master."
She pressed her face against his knee, her breath warm, carrying a hint of cautious dependence and expectation.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
